Bash(git commit -m "Fix Xcode build error by removing OpenVPNClient.h from public module

OpenVPNClient.h is a C++ implementation detail that includes ovpncli.hpp,
which causes build failures when the module is imported by Swift/Objective-C
code in Xcode projects.

The error was:
''client/ovpncli.hpp'' file not found

OpenVPNClient.h should remain internal only and not be exposed in the 
public module map. It''s only used internally by OpenVPNAdapter.mm.

This fixes the iOS app integration where the PacketTunnelProvider
couldn''t import the OpenVPNAdapter module.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>")

Bash(git commit -m "Add disableClientCert property to fix ''Missing External PKI alias'' error

The error ''Missing External PKI alias'' occurs when OpenVPN3 expects 
client certificate authentication but the configuration uses 
username/password authentication instead.

Added the disableClientCert property to OpenVPNConfiguration which 
allows disabling client certificate requirement for password-based
authentication. The implementation was already present in the .mm file
but was missing from the public header.

This property should be set to YES when using username/password 
authentication without client certificates (common for services 
like Windscribe).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>")

Bash(git commit -m "Fix DNS options parsing error in OpenVPNClient

The error ""ERR_PROFILE_OPTION: option_error: tun_builder_set_dns_options failed""
was caused by the missing tun_builder_set_dns_options method implementation.

OpenVPN3 3.11.7 uses a new DnsOptions structure to pass DNS settings instead
of individual DNS server calls. This method processes the DnsOptions object
which contains:
- DNS servers with priorities and addresses
- Search domains (both per-server and global)
- DNS security and transport settings

The implementation iterates through all DNS servers and their associated
domains, calling the existing delegate methods to configure them.

This fixes the connection error when OpenVPN3 tries to configure DNS settings.")
